'''Anna Maria Fino''' is an Italian mathematician specializing in [[differential geometry]], [[complex geometry]], and [[Lie group]]s. She is a professor of mathematics in the Giuseppe Peano Department of Mathematics at the [[University of Turin]],{{r|cv}} and founding editor-in-chief of the journal ''Complex Manifolds''.{{r|cm}}

==Education and career==
Fino earned a [[laurea]] in mathematics in 1992 from the University of Turin.{{r|cv}} She completed her Ph.D. in 1997 through the Genoa-Turin University Consortium, with a dissertation ''Geometria e topologia degli spazi omogenei'' [''Geometry and topology of homogeneous spaces''] supervised by Simon Salamon.{{r|cv|mg}}

She remained as a researcher at the University of Turin until 2005, when she became an associate professor. She earned a [[habilitation]] in 2013 and was promoted to full professor in 2015.{{r|cv}}

She has been editor-in-chief of ''Complex Manifolds'' since 2014{{r|cv}} when it first began publication,{{r|cm}} as part of De Gruyter's "Emerging Science Journals" line of open-access journals.{{r|open}}
